heroReference.videoIntent: 参考页面是静态作品浏览，通过大画面和缩略图呈现制作任务。本站保留层级与相邻布局，加入适用的视频案例。

visualStyle.medium: 静态照片和作品缩略图
visualStyle.colorAndLight: 竞品观察到亮作品和深表面之间有层次，本站使用暖纸色、陶红与炭黑。
visualStyle.pacing: 选择缩略图后替换主画面，无可播放视频节奏。
visualStyle.composition: 主媒体宽画布，缩略图下置；移动随表单纵向重排。
visualStyle.narrative: 让用户先看输出再决定是否尝试。

heroReference.notBorrowed: 竞品人物、图片、文字、品牌、色彩与产品承诺

media.sourceHeading: What Is AI Video Expander?
media.meaning: 解释源片如何适应新画幅
media.story: 编辑台上一道光框由窄扩宽，透过框看到两个不同发布场景。
media.mechanism: 关键词随画框展开，接续一竖一横两段可识别场景。
media.reason: 镜头关系能呈现画幅改变，新增区便于在播放中观察。
media.prompt: Ten-second title-led motion film, muted ochre and charcoal. A narrow luminous terracotta frame opens out across a black film leader, and the words AI Video Expander slide into focus with the opening. Hold that single correctly spelled phrase long enough to read, with strong light-on-dark contrast and no other type. The frame carries into a tall view of a cyclist on a concrete terrace, then into a wide view of musicians entering a small rehearsal space. Frame lines reveal extra surroundings before dissolving. Keep cuts precise, textures photographic and subjects easy to see. Soft film-projector rhythm, no voice.
media.exclusions: Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.

media.sourceHeading: Choose the Shape of Your Video
media.meaning: 一次拍摄转成新的画幅
media.story: 滑雪者越过红旗，雪地构图为竖版增加天空与坡面。
media.mechanism: 横向源取景和竖向成品同时可辨。
media.reason: 镜头关系能呈现画幅改变，新增区便于在播放中观察。
media.prompt: On a restrained dark film-viewer background, a skier in a navy shell crosses an orange boundary flag on a sunlit alpine slope. The large vertical moving image has powder and sky extending above and below the skier. Keep one small widescreen view of the same skier at the far left against clean charcoal empty space, with the main vertical moving image on the right. The camera stays locked. Snow spray trails the turn and settles. No labels or borders over the skier.
media.exclusions: Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.
media.insetSafeArea: 左侧炭黑空白区域，避免遮挡右侧主画面

media.sourceHeading: Keep the Whole Source Frame
media.meaning: 扩幅中保留原始构图
media.story: 室内红绿扶手椅上的两位受访者同时入画，留出上下空间。
media.mechanism: 人和两把椅子始终留在中央源区域。
media.reason: 首要主体和变化在小视口仍清楚，场景动作可一次拍完整。
media.prompt: A fixed-camera moving portrait crop of two adult interview guests seated in rust-red and forest-green armchairs in a plaster room. Both chairs and both faces remain visible. One guest nods and the other closes a small notebook. The larger continuing shot above and below shows ceiling and wood floor. A single tiny horizontal moving strip sits at the left in a generous black margin, outside the area with the chairs, and gives an alternate framing of those same subjects. Bright north light and a restrained film-grain texture. No text.
media.exclusions: Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.
media.insetSafeArea: 左侧独立黑边，椅子及人物在右侧全画幅

media.sourceHeading: Describe What Belongs at the Edges
media.meaning: 说明文字如何引导新增区域
media.story: 修理员将台灯拉亮，墙面延伸出一块可放标题的空间。
media.mechanism: 台灯、工具和墙面在明确视线方向分开。
media.reason: 将注意力放在任务成品，单镜头保持变化清楚。
media.prompt: A small bicycle repair bench under an anglepoise lamp. A mechanic in an indigo overshirt straightens a chrome spanner and turns on the lamp. The main wide image on the right gives the workshop an extended bare sandy plaster wall beside the bench, with shallow side light and no graphics on the wall. A single small moving narrow view on the far left in clear dark empty space shows the lamp and spanner without the full wall. Keep the materials matte, the lamp sharp and the camera fixed. No text.
media.exclusions: Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.
media.insetSafeArea: 左侧空暗边，不覆盖右侧灯与延伸墙面

media.sourceHeading: Set the Output Resolution
media.meaning: 展示适合输出的视觉细节
media.story: 印刷工掀起一张带细线纹理的纸，从横向构图看清纹理。
media.mechanism: 成品画面中的网纹、纸边和印刷色帮助理解输出细节。
media.reason: 镜头关系能呈现画幅改变，新增区便于在播放中观察。
media.prompt: A fixed landscape shot across a screen-printing table, shot close enough to catch paper grain and finely printed rust-orange lines. An adult printmaker draws the squeegee slowly across an inked screen, lifts it and sets the finished paper down in the middle of the wide frame. A navy apron and a strip of natural window light balance the burnt orange. The image holds steady at the end so the edge texture remains legible. No UI, labels, size claims or comparison frames.
media.exclusions: Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.

media.sourceHeading: Turn a Wide Shot into a Vertical Post
media.meaning: 双人采访竖版保留两人，留出字幕位置
media.story: 采访结束前两位嘉宾同时笑起来，椅子和两张脸在竖版中央有分量。
media.mechanism: 纵向构图留出上下空间。
media.reason: 首要主体和变化在小视口仍清楚，场景动作可一次拍完整。
media.prompt: A ten-second vertical independent magazine interview. Two adults in adjacent chairs, one in a pale blue shirt and one in a black jacket, exchange a glance and share a brief laugh. Keep both faces and both bodies within the same tall composition, with an unpatterned buff wall above and a clear dark rug below for future captions. Window light washes the side of the small theatre lounge. Film at seated eye height with a fixed camera. No letters or captions; quiet room sound.
media.exclusions: Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.

media.sourceHeading: Make Room for a Product Headline
media.meaning: 横向广告给标题预留侧面空白
media.story: 架上的红色便携唱盘合盖，侧面墙依然干净。
media.mechanism: 单一商品靠左，横画幅另一侧留出安静空间。

media.prompt: A graphic 16:9 product placement with a burnt-red portable record player on the left of a stone bench. Its clear lid clicks shut as a record slows underneath. Static camera at bench level, slender white window reflections on the lid, with an open expanse of oatmeal plaster to the right. Leave that area readable as uninterrupted space for future titles. No people, logos or text. Keep shadows firm and realistic.

media.prompt: An ultrawide locked-off shot of a person in a sand-colored coat walking along a slate sea wall and pausing to look at the water. Keep the walker fully visible around the center, visually bracketed by the jetty masonry. The coast extends in both directions, with sea foam advancing across the dark stones and a thin line of granite on the distant horizon. A long mellow morning exposure, wind moving the coat hem, realistic wave sound and no titles.

media.sourceHeading: Step 1: Upload a Source Video

A tile with a film clip of a white skateboard on a terracotta bank is mid-move from a visible file stack toward a large outlined upload tray. Put a clear upward arrow inside the tray and a small legible MP4 file tag on the arriving video tile. Show the same white deck and ochre concrete in the tile. Render a clean orthographic studio diagram with restrained shadows and readable shapes. No extraneous interface and no text beyond MP4.
